tested_states.trigger: Open-Meteo API unreachable or client in Airplane Mode without cached weather.
tested_states.ui_behavior: Weather capsule transforms cleanly to '[☁ Weather Unavailable]' with subtle muted border. Zero blank space or broken NaN layout.

tested_states.trigger: Unverified or draft place lacking audited photography.
tested_states.ui_behavior: Quality gate enforced: place is NOT published to Discover feed. If accessed via internal staging/debug, renders dignified sandstone geometric monogram placeholder with '[Audited Photography Pending]' badge.

tested_states.trigger: Device has no cellular/WiFi, but user has opened place/trip previously.
tested_states.ui_behavior: Persistent discreet top banner: '[Offline Mode · Viewing Cached Itinerary]'. All text, timings, coordinates, and cached WebP images remain fully interactive.

tested_states.trigger: Device offline and attempting to open un-cached distant destination or cloud sync.
tested_states.ui_behavior: Dignified ContentUnavailableView: 'Destination Not Downloaded · Connect to Internet or Download District Offline Package in Settings'.

tested_states.trigger: Aiven DB or FastAPI backend endpoint down / returning HTTP 5xx.
tested_states.ui_behavior: Non-blocking persistent warning bar: 'Server Temporarily Unreachable · Operating on Local Cache'. Inline 'Tap to Retry' action. Zero raw stack traces.

tested_states.trigger: Cloud LLM endpoints unreachable or timed out.
tested_states.ui_behavior: Planner switches seamlessly to local deterministic solvers: '[⚡ Algorithmic Solver Active · Based on Verified Transit Timetables]'. Cultural chat switches to verified FAQ database.

tested_states.trigger: Device offline or AI services disabled.
tested_states.ui_behavior: Natural language chat input gracefully collapses; structured form controls (Days, Pace, Corridor) remain 100% active and functional.

tested_states.trigger: Bus stop coordinates sourced from candidate data without physical field verification.
tested_states.ui_behavior: Rendered strictly as dashed amber circle on map with badge '[◌ Candidate Stop · Unverified GPS]'. Prompts traveler: 'Verify This Stop' via community consensus check-in.

tested_states.trigger: Transit stop has locality name but zero physical signboard coordinates.
tested_states.ui_behavior: Never plotted as exact pin on map. Displays as an administrative chip '[Service Area: Chandrasekharpur]' with schedule listing.

tested_states.trigger: Bus route lacks validated high-precision road-following GPS trace.
tested_states.ui_behavior: Polyline omitted from map to avoid drawing misleading straight lines across rivers or forests. Route stop sequence listed as ordered timeline.

App switches automatically to 'Statewide Overview' reference datum. FirstMileEngine walking distance pills are completely hidden. Non-intrusive banner: 'Enable location for walking distances to stops'.

tested_states.trigger: Traveler attempts to upload community contribution photo or take camera check-in.
tested_states.ui_behavior: Contextual, in-place permission primer explaining exact cultural preservation purpose before system dialog triggers. Allows photo picker as zero-permission fallback.
Dignified empty state: 'No Saved Journeys Yet' with inspiring CTA 'Explore 3-Day Golden Triangle' (pre-solved golden circuit).

tested_states.trigger: Planner solves 2 out of 3 requested destinations due to museum closing hours on Monday.
tested_states.ui_behavior: Clear honest disclosure: 'State Museum closed on Mondays · Substituted with Khandagiri Caves · Schedule verified'. Zero silent omissions.

stress_test_evaluation.ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL: PASS — 14/14 states handled with high visual dignity and M3 container consistency.
stress_test_evaluation.ANDROID_B_FIELD_GUIDE: PASS — 14/14 states handled with high operational utility, though slightly dry visually.
stress_test_evaluation.ANDROID_C_LIVING_ODISHA: FAIL/MARGINAL — Complex magazine layouts broke down under ITINERARY_PARTIAL and MEDIA_MISSING; empty states felt cluttered.
stress_test_evaluation.IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS: PASS — 14/14 states handled natively using SwiftUI ContentUnavailableView, Section footers, and vibrant capsules.
stress_test_evaluation.IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY: FAIL/MARGINAL — Continuous map background clashed with OFFLINE_NO_CACHE and BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE modal overlays.
stress_test_evaluation.IOS_C_GLASS_HERITAGE: FAIL/MARGINAL — Frosted glass blur reduced contrast of error banners and truth state indicators in sunlight.
